decisions.reason: The award-winning high-pressure probe builds directly on the firm's established geothermal probe know-how, and the industry recognition shows the firm can read and use market feedback to refine it.
A single-U borehole heat exchanger is a close extension of the firm's existing probe portfolio, so the firm already holds the knowledge to interpret its results and improve it.
The surface technology complements the probe line and draws on existing materials and processing competence, so it can be assimilated and developed further at low risk.
Fire-protection steel profile systems are at the heart of the firm's core steel profile expertise and certification experience, giving strong absorptive capacity for further development.
Slim steel profiles build directly on the firm's established profile engineering and meet growing architectural demand, so the firm can learn from early results and improve the system.
The decorative surface system extends existing steel profile and surface finishing know-how, so it fits the firm's knowledge base even though its market value is less certain.
